summary:
Complete WebXR 90 FPS Performance & Spatial UI Refactoring Plan:
- Enforce strict Zero-State & Zero-Allocation in useFrame (useRef only, pre-allocated Vector3/Quat/Matrix).
- 100% InstancedMesh object pooling for bullets, enemies, particles, data shards, and floating score popups.
- High-contrast Spatial 3D UI using solid #020611 backing plates and crisp @react-three/drei Text, eliminating HTML overlay limitations in WebXR.
- Strict 2-Phase Warp-to-Defend flow (Phase 1 Distant Core at Z: -40, Question high at Y: 4.5, Badges at Y: 1.0; Phase 2 Forward Dash to Z: -25).
- Arcade Juice: 50ms Hit-Stop, Electric Gold Fever Mode, Magnetic Data Shard suction, and New Record celebration.
